content:
{'translation': "Earlier this year, we learned that Volvo plans to support features like Apple Music's Spatial Audio through an update to CarPlay. Today, Volvo confirmed the support again and detailed the availability of the audio upgrade."}

{'translation': 'In January this year, Volvo pledged to continue supporting Apple CarPlay, even as some car manufacturers like GM reduced support in certain models. At the time, we also mentioned that the Volvo EX60 SUV would support Spatial Audio via CarPlay.'}

{'translation': 'Today, Volvo released new details about the Spatial Audio feature, particularly for the EX90:'}

{'translation': 'The latest software update also brings Spatial Audio support for CarPlay* to the Volvo EX90 equipped with Dolby Atmos technology. Through the premium Bowers & Wilkins sound system, which includes 25 high-performance speakers, Volvo drivers can enjoy a multi-dimensional, immersive audio experience, with music and vocals enveloping the entire cabin. From favourite songs and live performances to podcasts, Spatial Audio powered by Dolby Atmos adds layers and detail to every piece of audio you listen to — making every drive richer, more engaging, and more enjoyable.'}

{'translation': 'Volvo added: "Spatial Audio on CarPlay requires the Bowers & Wilkins sound system to deliver the full immersive experience, which can be selected when ordering the Volvo EX60, EX90 and ES90."'}

{'translation': 'Not planning to buy a new car anytime soon? Earlier this year, Pioneer launched the first aftermarket CarPlay system to support Dolby Atmos Spatial Audio playback.'}
